Listen to 9to5Mac Daily for your daily digest of the top Apple news headlines. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or via RSS for Overcast and other podcast players.

This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you organize everything in your mind into a simple and elegant system, clearing all your loose ends and reducing mental strain. It's an easy-to-use to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organizing, following up on, and completing tasks deeply satisfying. Get Stuff done.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears as soon as they drop.

News discussed in this episode:

  • A brand-new iPad mini with an OLED display is expected to launch before the end of October.
  • John Ternus makes his first public appearance as Apple CEO and outlines his priorities.
  • Apple updates its executive team page to reflect John Ternus as the new CEO.
  • Apple reveals what it calls "smoking gun" evidence from a former employee's MacBook in its lawsuit against OpenAI.
